text: 为啥反对卖淫合法的成劳保了？
en: Why has opposing the legalisation of prostitution turned one into a conservative?

text: 我寻思这五千年历史合法才是常态啊
en: I should think that, given five thousand years of history, being legal is the normal state of affairs.

text: 网上三大弱zhi观点。
en: The three most idiotic views on the internet.

text: 一是卖合法化。
en: The first is the legalisation of prostitution.

text: 二是持枪合法，三是废死。
en: The second is the legalisation of gun ownership, and the third is the abolition of the death penalty.

text: 梅毒从美洲传入中国后，首先在汉地流传，随后从汉地传入了蒙古
en: After syphilis was introduced to China from the Americas, it first spread in the Han areas, and then from the Han areas it spread to the Mongol regions.

text: 到清末民初的时候，梅毒在蒙古族地区的传播已经到了骇人听闻的程度，根据建国以后的调查，很多蒙古族聚居区的梅毒患病率高达半数至2/3的程度，整片地区找不到几个正常人也是司空见惯。
en: By the late Qing and early Republican period, the spread of syphilis in Mongol areas had reached a horrifying extent; according to surveys conducted after the founding of the PRC, the syphilis prevalence rate in many Mongol settlement areas reached as high as half to two-thirds, and for an entire region to have scarcely any healthy people was commonplace.

text: 梅毒的广泛传播给蒙古族带来了灾难性的后果。
en: The widespread transmission of syphilis brought catastrophic consequences to the Mongol people.

text: 大量蒙古年轻人因为患梅毒而死亡，残疾或者失去生育能力。
en: Large numbers of young Mongols died, were disabled, or lost their fertility as a result of contracting syphilis.

text: 妇女患有梅毒导致生育的胎儿大量夭折或畸形。
en: Syphilis in women caused a great many of their foetuses to die young or to be born deformed.

text: 梅毒对蒙古人的杀伤力如此之强，以至于在清朝中后期多数地区和民族都出现人口爆炸的前提下，蒙古族人口居然从清朝到新中国建国都在持续下降。
en: The lethality of syphilis against the Mongols was so great that, even as most regions and ethnic groups experienced a population explosion in the mid-to-late Qing dynasty, the Mongol population actually continued to decline from the Qing dynasty right up to the founding of New China.

text: 民国时期考察了蒙古族地区情况的日本人在目睹了牧区梅毒泛滥的惨状后，干脆认为“蒙古民族已经有被梅毒灭绝的风险”。
en: Japanese who investigated conditions in Mongol areas during the Republican period, after witnessing the tragic state of syphilis running rampant in the pastoral regions, went so far as to claim that "the Mongol nation was at risk of being wiped out by syphilis".

text: 在汉地人口爆炸而牧区人口因为梅毒流行而萎缩的情况下，从清朝末年开始，汉地人口开始大规模涌入蒙古族聚居区，形成了清末三大人口迁徙之一的“走西口”，从而深刻的改变了今天内蒙古地区的人口结构。
en: As the Han areas experienced a population explosion while the pastoral regions shrank owing to the syphilis epidemic, from the end of the Qing dynasty the Han population began to flood into Mongol settlement areas on a large scale, forming one of the three great migrations of the late Qing — the westward migration through the passes — which profoundly altered the demographic structure of Inner Mongolia as it is today.

text: 蒙古地区梅毒流行的问题直到新中国在牧区建立了完善的医疗卫生体系，普及抗生素治疗和改变滥交习俗之后才彻底解决。
en: The problem of the syphilis epidemic in the Mongol regions was not thoroughly resolved until New China established a comprehensive medical and healthcare system in the pastoral areas, popularised antibiotic treatment, and changed the custom of promiscuity.

text: 问题来了，梅毒明明是从汉地传入蒙古的，为何在蒙古危害如此之大，在汉地却没有造成这种毁灭性的影响？
en: Here is the question: syphilis clearly was introduced to the Mongol regions from the Han areas, so why did it cause such enormous harm among the Mongols, yet fail to produce this kind of devastating impact in the Han areas?

text: 其中一个最重要的原因就是当时的蒙古族牧区滥交情况严重。
en: One of the most important reasons is that promiscuity was severe in the Mongol pastoral areas at that time.

text: 生活在北方草原的民族由于其特殊的自然环境，生产力条件和社会结构，从未建立起中原地区的贞操观念，年轻男女之间成年之后经常会随意交媾。
en: The peoples living on the northern steppe, owing to their special natural environment, productive conditions, and social structure, never established the chastity concepts of the Central Plains; once they came of age, young men and women would frequently copulate at will.

text: 每个部落甚至会刻意让本部落年轻女性尽可能多的与优质的外来男性交配，以获得优质的下一代。
en: Each tribe would even deliberately encourage its young women to mate with as many high-quality outside men as possible, in order to obtain a superior next generation.

text: 这种滥交情况在清朝时期变得更加严重。
en: This promiscuous behaviour became even more severe during the Qing dynasty.

text: 客观原因是清王朝大规模推广黄教，大量蒙古年轻男性成为喇嘛，导致本来就人口不足的草原地区可育男性数量进一步下跌。
en: The objective reason was that the Qing court promoted the Yellow Sect on a large scale, and large numbers of young Mongol men became lamas, which caused the number of fertile men in the already underpopulated steppe regions to fall further.

text: 男丁数量减少迫使草原上的年轻女性必须抓住尽可能多的机会与合适的男性交媾以确保部落繁衍，使得滥交情况更加普遍。
en: The reduction in the number of men forced young women on the steppe to seize every possible opportunity to copulate with suitable men in order to ensure the tribe's reproduction, making promiscuous behaviour even more widespread.

text: 在这种情况下，梅毒便在草原上随着普遍的滥交而以空前迅猛的速度传播开来，形成了规模巨大的群体性感染。
en: Under these circumstances, syphilis spread across the steppe with unprecedented rapidity alongside the widespread promiscuity, forming a massive collective infection.

text: 这种感染很快迫使草原上进入了恶性循环：梅毒流行导致的死亡，残疾和生育能力丧失导致草原上可育年轻人变少；可育年轻人变少迫使每一个年轻男女都需要抓住机会和尽可能多的异性交媾来确保种群延续，使得滥交行为更普遍；滥交越普遍则梅毒传播越快。
en: This infection soon forced the steppe into a vicious cycle: the deaths, disabilities, and loss of fertility caused by the syphilis epidemic reduced the number of fertile young people on the steppe; the shortage of fertile young people forced every young man and woman to seize opportunities to copulate with as many members of the opposite sex as possible to ensure the survival of the population, making promiscuous behaviour still more common; and the more widespread the promiscuity, the faster the syphilis spread.

text: 在民国时期曾经有西方学者调查发现，牧区的每个蒙古族年轻女性平均会和十个异性发生性关系。
en: During the Republican period, Western scholars who conducted investigations found that, on average, each young Mongol woman in the pastoral areas would have sexual relations with ten members of the opposite sex.

text: 这种“越滥交越传染，越传染越滥交”的死亡循环最终导致了晚清到民国时期草原人口的灾难性崩溃。
en: This death spiral of "the more promiscuous, the more infection; the more infection, the more promiscuous" ultimately led to the catastrophic collapse of the steppe population from the late Qing to the Republican period.

text: 不仅蒙古族已经处在灭亡边缘，连清朝中后期迁移到草原生活的汉人也因为入乡随俗而大面积感染。
en: Not only were the Mongols already on the brink of extinction, but even the Han people who had migrated to the steppe to live there in the mid-to-late Qing dynasty were infected on a large scale because they adopted the local customs.

text: 与此同时，梅毒在汉地的传播则进入了另一个极端：虽然梅毒最早在明朝就可能进入了中国，但由于汉地对女性贞操观念的极端重视，对婚前和婚外性行为的严格排斥，使得在汉地，无论是权贵阶层，还是平民百姓都会严格控制普通人尤其是年轻女性的交媾对象，在多数情况下每个女性终其一生都只会有一个性伴侣。
en: At the same time, the spread of syphilis in the Han areas entered the opposite extreme: although syphilis may have entered China as early as the Ming dynasty, because of the Han people's extreme emphasis on female chastity and their strict rejection of premarital and extramarital sexual behaviour, in the Han areas both the ruling class and ordinary commoners strictly controlled the sexual partners of ordinary people, especially young women; in most cases a woman would have only one sexual partner in her entire life.

text: 即使在中下层社会，相对来说不会排斥女性的再嫁等行为，但像草原地区那样的大规模滥交仍然是不可想象的。
en: Even in the lower and middle strata of society, where the remarriage of women and the like was relatively less rejected, large-scale promiscuity of the kind seen in the steppe regions remained inconceivable.

text: 在这种情况下，在草原地区广泛传播，造成毁灭性破坏的梅毒等性传播疾病，在汉地最终变成了一种只能在妓女-嫖客的小圈子里进行局部传播的疾病。
en: Under these circumstances, sexually transmitted diseases such as syphilis, which spread widely and caused devastating damage in the steppe regions, ultimately became in the Han areas a disease that could only transmit locally within the small circle of prostitutes and their clients.

text: 而且由于主流社会对于这个圈子的极端排斥，以及妓女-嫖客圈外的女性仍然被严格限制交配对象，导致梅毒在妓女-嫖客圈以外完全没有发生大范围传播的机会。
en: Moreover, because mainstream society rejected this circle extremely, and women outside the prostitute–client circle were still strictly restricted in their sexual partners, syphilis had absolutely no opportunity to spread on a large scale beyond the prostitute–client circle.

text: 即便在汉地一直只能在小圈子里传播，以梅毒为首的各类性病仍然展现了强大的破坏力。
en: Even though in the Han areas it could only ever spread within small circles, sexually transmitted diseases led by syphilis still demonstrated formidable destructive power.

text: 在新中国建立以后的调查中发现，上海地区妓女的性病感染率高达65%，其中大多数是梅毒和淋病。
en: Surveys conducted after the establishment of New China found that the sexually transmitted disease infection rate among prostitutes in the Shanghai area reached as high as 65%, the majority of which were syphilis and gonorrhoea.

text: 然而我们依然要庆幸，由于新中国建立以后基本扫除了原有的庞大妓女群体，并帮助包括蒙古族在内的各族人民改善了卫生环境和风俗习惯，从而在80年代之前基本消除了性病在国内大范围传播的隐患。
en: Nevertheless, we should still be thankful that, because New China essentially eliminated the original vast community of prostitutes after its establishment and helped all ethnic groups, including the Mongols, to improve their sanitary environment and customs, the hidden danger of sexually transmitted diseases spreading widely within the country was essentially removed before the 1980s.

text: 因为就在80年代，一个比梅毒和淋病更加恐怖的性传播疾病出现了
en: For in the 1980s, a sexually transmitted disease even more terrifying than syphilis and gonorrhoea appeared.

text: 艾滋病毒的破坏力在非洲地区体现的最为明显，非洲地区糟糕的医疗卫生条件和普遍存在的对贞操观念的漠视，广泛的滥交行为，与一百年前的中国北方草原地区如出一辙。
en: The destructive power of HIV is most clearly manifested in Africa; Africa's poor medical and health conditions, the widespread disregard for the concept of chastity, and the prevalent promiscuous behaviour are exactly the same as in the northern Chinese steppe a hundred years ago.

text: 尽管艾滋病毒的广泛流行到今天也不过四五十年，但非洲的艾滋患病率已经到了极其恐怖的程度，南非的艾滋感染率超过20%，而更多的非洲国家则由于缺乏统计而根本无法确知其患病情况。
en: Although the widespread prevalence of HIV has been with us for no more than forty or fifty years to this day, the AIDS prevalence rate in Africa has reached an extremely frightening level; in South Africa the HIV infection rate exceeds 20%, while even more African countries, owing to a lack of statistics, simply cannot ascertain their true prevalence.

text: 在全球其它地区，艾滋病同样借助人群的滥交（特别是同性性行为）实现了大范围传播。
en: In other parts of the world, AIDS has likewise achieved widespread transmission by means of human promiscuity (especially same-sex sexual behaviour).

text: 在中国，自80年代以来，估计艾滋感染者数量早已超过百万—而且其中绝大多数都选择了对社会和身边人隐瞒病情。
en: In China, since the 1980s, the estimated number of people living with HIV has long surpassed one million — and the vast majority of them have chosen to conceal their condition from society and those around them.

text: 由于艾滋感染者数量连年增加，与艾滋有关的社会事件也越来越多。
en: As the number of people living with HIV has increased year after year, social incidents related to AIDS have also grown ever more numerous.

text: 近年来已经多次发生艾滋患者通过约P等方式故意传播疾病以报复社会的事情。
en: In recent years there have been multiple incidents in which people with AIDS have deliberately transmitted the disease through hookups and similar means in order to take revenge on society.

text: 无论如何，作为一种需要双方发生亲密接触的行为，性行为本身就是一种对个体而言有较大风险的事情。
en: In any case, as a behaviour requiring intimate contact between two parties, sexual activity itself is something that carries considerable risk for the individual.

text: 这不仅意味着可能感染疾病，女性还需要承担性行为带来的生育/流产对身体的损害。
en: This does not only mean the possible infection with disease; women must also bear the physical damage to their bodies caused by the pregnancy or abortion that sexual activity brings.

text: 全世界几乎所有地区的人类在进入文明时代以后基本都会选择严格限制和约束社会成员的性关系对象，不惜动用社会力量甚至公权力来抵制甚至惩罚滥交行为，很可能是人类社会在运行过程中意识到随意和不受控的性关系可能会对社会公共利益造成严重损害。
en: Almost all human societies across the world, after entering the age of civilisation, have essentially chosen to strictly limit and restrain the sexual partners of their members, going so far as to mobilise social forces and even public power to resist and even punish promiscuous behaviour — most likely because human society, in the course of its operation, came to realise that casual and uncontrolled sexual relations could cause serious harm to the public interest of society.

text: 在今天，讨论与性相关的话题时，我们仍然应该时刻牢记，性可以带来欢愉，但发生性关系同时也是一件风险极大，极其严肃的事情。
en: Today, when discussing topics related to sex, we should still constantly bear in mind that sex can bring pleasure, but engaging in sexual relations is at the same time something of extremely great risk and utmost seriousness.

text: 不受约束的性关系曾经给很多人类社会族群和个体带来过巨大痛苦，而且直到今天还在制造更多的痛苦—无数罹患性病和艾滋的患者，未婚先孕的少女，因为反复流产而患病甚至丧失生育能力的女孩，甚至还有无数因为不在父母预期之内出生而被遗弃/冷落的孩子，都是那些不安全和不负责任的性关系对人类社会带来的负面影响。
en: Unrestrained sexual relations have brought great suffering to many human societies, ethnic groups, and individuals, and to this day they continue to create even more pain — the countless patients suffering from sexually transmitted diseases and AIDS, the teenage girls who became pregnant before marriage, the girls who fell ill or even lost their fertility through repeated abortions, and even the countless children who were abandoned or neglected because they were born outside their parents' expectations, are all the negative consequences that unsafe and irresponsible sexual relations have brought upon human society.

text: 性行为不是禁忌，它不可怕，不可耻。
en: Sexual activity is not a taboo; it is not frightening, and it is not shameful.

text: 但它也不应该是一件可以随意为之，视为普通的娱乐项目的事情。
en: But it also should not be something one does at will, treating it as an ordinary form of entertainment.

text: 事实上，它始终应该是一件被严肃对待的话题。
en: In fact, it should always be a subject that is treated with seriousness.
